summary: 11 countries today. The Iran war and the Strait of Hormuz standoff still set the tone abroad, and Washington's new sanctions on the ICC president drew notice from Paris to Mexico City. Around that, the day spreads wide: US debt passing 40 trillion dollars, a last-minute tariff reprieve for Canada, the Korea drills cut back hours before they began, a Wall Street exodus seen from Istanbul, Kenyan coffee exports doubling, Russian watches selling well in America, and the world's ugliest dog.
